hero_subtitle: Walk with a local. Taste real stories. See the side of Malaysia most visitors never reach.
hero_description: Our walking food tours are rooted in heritage and guided with heart.
manifesto_headline: In Malaysia, food is how stories get told.
manifesto_tagline: The best ones stay with you.
manifesto_body: We believe you cannot tell a story without the people, the food, and the place. Fourteen years in, we are still learning all three.
pillars_intro: Everything we do comes back to three things.
pillar_people_heading: Behind every dish is someone who has spent a lifetime perfecting it.
pillar_people_body: We introduce you to them: the hawkers, the families, the vendors who have fed their neighbourhoods for generations.
pillar_food_heading: Malaysian food is one of the most layered cuisines in the world.
pillar_food_body: Chinese, Malay, Indian, Peranakan - each culture cooking side by side for 200 years. Every dish has a history. We help you taste it.
pillar_place_heading: The stalls, the markets, the narrow lanes, the kampung that refused to be demolished.
pillar_place_body: Malaysias food culture lives in specific places. Many of them are disappearing. Coming here is how they survive.
vendors_subtitle: The people who make Malaysian food culture what it is
segment_heading: There is a tour for your kind of curious
segment_subheading: Tell us what matters - we will show you the right one.
about_title: Born in Malaysia. Raised on Street Food.
about_subtitle: Sharing the Malaysia we grew up with, one meal at a time.
about_description: Simply Enak has been sharing Malaysian food heritage since 2011. We started as a small food walk through Kuala Lumpur's oldest neighborhoods, led by Pauline who grew up exploring wet markets and hawker stalls with her family. Today we host 5,000+ guests a year across KL and Penang — still with the same approach: unscripted, human, and deeply personal.
expect_subtitle: How our food tours actually work
expect_stat1_body: You are never lost in a crowd. Everyone can ask questions, wander, and actually connect.
expect_stat2_body: Every stop is a vendor we have eaten with for years. No commissions. No tourist traps.
expect_stat3_body: We do not take money from the people we visit. Their food speaks for itself.
expect_stat4_body: We know who opened, who closed, and who has been cooking the same recipe since 1978.
cta_subtitle: Join us for your next Malaysian adventure. Small groups, real neighborhoods, unforgettable stories.
